name: Real-ESRGAN
tagline: Fast CLI and Vulkan AI image super-resolution engine for batch upscaling
real_test_summary: Upscaled 50 product thumbnails by 4x via realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan CLI on a 4GB VRAM laptop GPU in 19 seconds.
pros: Standalone portable Vulkan binaries need zero Python setup
Ideal for automated CLI batch pipelines
cons: Command-line interface only (use Upscayl for GUI)
Can over-smooth fine skin textures on default settings
description: Practical blind image restoration and 4x anime/photo upscaling model with portable NCNN-Vulkan binaries that run offline without Python or CUDA.
